clean.text:
# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We want this project to be respectful, constructive, and technically honest.

## Standards

- Be respectful.
- Discuss ideas, not people.
- Prefer evidence and reproducible examples.
- Avoid misleading claims about detection or guaranteed watermark removal.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may remove abusive or harmful contributions.
